metadata.description: Claude Code mods from Ben AI (benai-mods), kept in dotfiles. Install from ~/.claude/rz-mods so the mods resolve the home folder correctly.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Offers to shape a long, loose prompt into a four-part brief, asking up to three questions about real gaps first

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 250k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, then copies it or starts a new chat with it

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: A task progress bar above the prompt and a side pane with one live card per subagent

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule in CLAUDE.md or in a rules folder

plugins.name: mod-index
plugins.description: /mods opens a side pane with every mod enabled in this profile, when it runs and how to call it

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane listing the to-do list, connectors, context files and skills this chat used
